description: End-to-end test suite for OAuth client CRUD operations using Playwright, testing creation, editing, deletion, and validation of OAuth clients with various configurations.

methods.name: loginAsSeededAdminAndGoToOAuthSettings
methods.description: Logs in as a seeded admin user and navigates to OAuth settings page.

methods.name: createOAuthClient
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth client via UI form, returns clientId and clientSecret.

methods.name: updateOAuthClient
methods.description: Updates an existing OAuth client with new details.

methods.name: deleteOAuthClient
methods.description: Deletes an OAuth client and verifies its removal from UI.

methods.name: expectOAuthClientInDb
methods.description: Asserts the database record matches expected OAuth client properties.

methods.name: expectOAuthClientDeletedInDb
methods.description: Asserts the OAuth client no longer exists in the database.

methods.name: expectOAuthClientDetails
methods.description: Verifies OAuth client details UI matches expected values.

methods.name: expectOAuthClientInList
methods.description: Checks that OAuth client appears in the list with correct name.

methods.name: goToOAuthSettings
methods.description: Navigates to OAuth settings page if not already there.

methods.name: uploadOAuthClientLogo
methods.description: Uploads a logo file for OAuth client via file chooser dialog.

methods.name: getFixturePath
methods.description: Constructs file path for fixture files.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCreateForm
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth client creation form element.

methods.name: getOAuthClientSubmittedModal
methods.description: Retrieves the modal element shown after client submission.

methods.name: getOAuthClientList
methods.description: Retrieves the list element of OAuth clients.

methods.name: getOAuthClientListItem
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OAuth client list item by clientId.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDetailsForm
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth client details form element.

methods.name: getOAuthClientPkceToggle
methods.description: Retrieves the PKCE toggle element.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCreateNameInput
methods.description: Retrieves the name input element in create form.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCreatePurposeInput
methods.description: Retrieves the purpose input element in create form.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCreateRedirectUriInput
methods.description: Retrieves the redirect URI input element in create form.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCreateWebsiteUrlInput
methods.description: Retrieves the website URL input element in create form.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDetailsNameInput
methods.description: Retrieves the name input element in details view.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDetailsPurposeInput
methods.description: Retrieves the purpose input element in details view.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDetailsRedirectUriInput
methods.description: Retrieves the redirect URI input element in details view.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDetailsWebsiteUrlInput
methods.description: Retrieves the website URL input element in details view.
